notes: Hold the disc and you can hear it now — spin it back and forth while a record plays and the audio follows your hand, at the pitch it was recorded at. Cover art no longer disappears on cases turned away from the lamp. The wall can be filed six ways, and filing by album or artist turns the thumb rail into a real A-Z index. There is a search box, a sleep timer that stops at the end of the record, and your whole collection can now be backed up to a file and restored.
